## Bodies allow `=`

```r
f(function(x) x = 1)
f(\(x) y = 1)
f(x = function(y) y = 1)
f(x <- function(y) y = 1)
f(function(x) x <- y = 1)
f(if (a) b = 1 else c = 2)
f(if (a) b else c = 2)
f(repeat x = 1)
f(while (a) x = 1)
f(for (i in x) y = 1)
function(x = function(y) y = 1) x
```
